title: The Ball in the Coal Shed
subtitle: 球类运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 球类运动（文学艺术与体育·体育与运动）
meta: 主题语境：球类运动（文学艺术与体育·体育与运动）　|　核心词汇：ball　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ball 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my uncle kept ① a ball in the coal shed for eleven years and said it was the only thing in the house that belonged to him. The ② ball, meaning the leather one and not the games, was too hard to head in winter and too soft by June; a ball, he said, is the only toy that tells you the truth about the weather.

Every ③ ball in that town was lost by a Sunday, and the ④ ball on the roof, meaning the one kicked there in March and not either of those, stayed until the rain brought it down in September. A ball, my mother said, is nine parts air and one part somebody willing to climb; my uncle said the air is the part you pay for twice.

My grandmother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ ball was the whole of an evening, meaning the dance and not the leather. The ⑥ ball, meaning the gathering and not any of that, began at eight and was judged by nine o'clock; a ball, she said, is either something you kick or the only party that requires a pair of shoes you do not own. She said the shoes were borrowed.

By 1974 the ⑦ ball had become a photograph on a sideboard, and the photograph had become an argument about who was in it. The ⑧ ball of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in April, was eleven years of Saturdays and one broken window; a ball, he said, is either the thing in the shed or the reason your name is in the book. She said the window was the honest half.

The ⑨ ball I remember is the leather one, which was cut open in 1978 and filled with sand for a doorstop. A ⑩ ball, my mother said in 1980, is the only possession that improves by being ruined; every ball, she said, is an afternoon that has agreed to look like an object. She said the afternoon is the part nobody keeps.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 球（球类运动的球）
B. n. 球（指那个皮球，与比赛相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a ball 留着／保存一个球
D. n. 球（指镇上每一个球）
E. n. 球（指屋顶上那个球）
F. n. 舞会（指那个夜晚的舞会）
G. n. 舞会（抽象：聚会这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a ball in the coal shed
The ball, meaning the leather one and not the games
ball was the whole of an evening
the ball had become a photograph on a sideboard
The ball of the whole thing
A ball, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: keep a ball 意为“留着／保存一个球”，1961 年叔叔在煤棚里留了一个球，留了十一年。
ball 意为“球”，指那个皮球而不是比赛，冬天硬得没法顶，到六月又太软。
ball 指镇上每一个球，那个镇上每一个球都是星期天之前丢的。
ball 指屋顶上那个球（三月被踢上去的那一个），一直待到九月雨水把它冲下来。
ball 意为“舞会”，祖母说它是一个夜晚的全部，指的是舞会而不是那个皮球。
ball 为抽象用法，指聚会这件事，八点开始，九点之前就被评判完了。
ball 意为“球”，到 1974 年这个 ball 成了餐具柜上的一张照片。
ball 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，叔叔四月写道，整件事权衡下来是十一个星期六和一扇破窗。
ball 意为“球”，我记得的是那个皮球，它在 1978 年被剖开、灌了沙当门挡。
ball 为抽象总称，母亲说球是唯一会因为被弄坏而变得更好的财物。
